sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 72

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 72:1
items.html: That is, phase one: that this screen of phase one, which brings out ten Sefirot in the level of VAK without a head, is what locks Beriah, so that everything that passes from there downward is the discernment of VAK without a head, that is, in the measure of Yetzirah. (Item 39).
